title: 🚢 Ship Tracker — World Map
description: Real-time AIS vessel positions on a world map. Stationary ships = dots, moving ships = directional arrows.

list.name: ship_category
list.label: Ship Category
list.description: Filter by ship type category (Cargo, Tanker, Passenger, etc.)
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT category FROM ship_types WHERE category IS NOT NULL ORDER BY category

list.name: ship_type_label
list.label: Ship Type
list.description: Filter by specific ship type label
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT label FROM ship_types WHERE ('${ship_category:raw}' = '' OR category IN (${ship_category:sqlstring})) ORDER BY label

list.name: speed_threshold
list.label: Moving threshold (knots)
list.description: Speed above which a ship is considered moving

panels.title: Ship Positions — World Map
panels.description: 🔵 Dots = stationary ships  |  🔴 Arrows = moving ships (arrow points in direction of travel).  Use the drop-downs above to filter by Ship Category and Ship Type.

targets.queryText: SELECT p.latitude  AS latitude, p.longitude AS longitude, v.ship_name   AS ship_name, COALESCE(st.label, 'Unknown')    AS ship_type, COALESCE(st.category, 'Unknown') AS category, COALESCE(p.speed_over_ground, 0) AS speed, COALESCE(p.course_over_ground, 0) AS course, v.mmsi AS mmsi, p.timestamp_utc AS time FROM position_history p JOIN vessels v ON v.mmsi = p.mmsi LEFT JOIN ship_types st ON st.ship_type = v.ship_type WHERE COALESCE(p.speed_over_ground, 0) < ${speed_threshold} AND ('${ship_category:raw}' = '' OR COALESCE(st.category, 'Unknown') IN (${ship_category:sqlstring})) AND ('${ship_type_label:raw}' = '' OR COALESCE(st.label, 'Unknown') IN (${ship_type_label:sqlstring})) AND p.id IN (SELECT MAX(p2.id) FROM position_history p2 GROUP BY p2.mmsi) ORDER BY p.timestamp_utc DESC LIMIT 10000

SELECT p.latitude  AS latitude, p.longitude AS longitude, v.ship_name   AS ship_name, COALESCE(st.label, 'Unknown')    AS ship_type, COALESCE(st.category, 'Unknown') AS category, COALESCE(p.speed_over_ground, 0) AS speed, COALESCE(p.course_over_ground, 0) AS course, v.mmsi AS mmsi, p.timestamp_utc AS time FROM position_history p JOIN vessels v ON v.mmsi = p.mmsi LEFT JOIN ship_types st ON st.ship_type = v.ship_type WHERE COALESCE(p.speed_over_ground, 0) >= ${speed_threshold} AND ('${ship_category:raw}' = '' OR COALESCE(st.category, 'Unknown') IN (${ship_category:sqlstring})) AND ('${ship_type_label:raw}' = '' OR COALESCE(st.label, 'Unknown') IN (${ship_type_label:sqlstring})) AND p.id IN (SELECT MAX(p2.id) FROM position_history p2 GROUP BY p2.mmsi) ORDER BY p.timestamp_utc DESC LIMIT 10000
SELECT COALESCE(st.category, 'Unknown') AS category, COUNT(DISTINCT v.mmsi) AS count FROM vessels v LEFT JOIN ship_types st ON st.ship_type = v.ship_type GROUP BY category ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.speed_over_ground, 0) >= ${speed_threshold} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS moving, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.speed_over_ground, 0) < ${speed_threshold} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stationary, COUNT(*) AS total FROM position_history p WHERE p.id IN (SELECT MAX(p2.id) FROM position_history p2 GROUP BY p2.mmsi)

SELECT v.ship_name, v.mmsi, COALESCE(st.label, 'Unknown') AS ship_type, COALESCE(st.category, 'Unknown') AS category, ROUND(p.latitude, 4) AS lat, ROUND(p.longitude, 4) AS lon, p.speed_over_ground AS speed_kn, ROUND(p.course_over_ground, 1) AS course, p.timestamp_utc AS last_report FROM position_history p JOIN vessels v ON v.mmsi = p.mmsi LEFT JOIN ship_types st ON st.ship_type = v.ship_type WHERE ('${ship_category:raw}' = '' OR COALESCE(st.category, 'Unknown') IN (${ship_category:sqlstring})) AND ('${ship_type_label:raw}' = '' OR COALESCE(st.label, 'Unknown') IN (${ship_type_label:sqlstring})) AND p.id IN (SELECT MAX(p2.id) FROM position_history p2 GROUP BY p2.mmsi) ORDER BY p.timestamp_utc DESC LIMIT 100
